description:
Please see attached Sources Sought document for details.  

  NOTE: This is a  refresh  of the Sources Sought and Project Labor Agreement (PLA) notice originally issued one year ago ( W9123626X1AW1 ). Updated responses are required to ensure our market research remains current and accurate.  

 Please identify your organization's status below and follow the corresponding action: 

  Previous Respondent (No Changes) -  Send a brief confirmation stating your initial response remains current and authorized for our market research. 

  Previous Respondent (With Changes) -  Submit an updated response addressing the refreshed requirements. 

  New Respondent (First-Time)  -   Follow the detailed instructions provided in this notice and submit your complete response as directed.
